title: TypedClaimCard
description: A structured scientific claim extracted from a source text. Every field is required. The schema is enforced by Pydantic at extraction time. Claim kinds and scale enums are domain-pack-scoped: the consciousness pack uses a narrower set than the physics pack. The canonical list below is the union; each domain pack specifies which values it uses.

claim_kind.description: The type of scientific commitment this claim makes. Domain-pack-scoped: the consciousness pack uses locus, temporal_profile, connectivity, substrate_dependence, computability, mechanism, observable_commitment. The physics pack adds measurement, scale, boundary. The MIU build listed denial as a kind; the corrected design encodes denial as commitment_direction=denies.

commitment_direction.description: Whether the theory asserts or denies this claim. Negation is a polarity field, not a separate claim kind. This keeps claim identity stable and makes forks computable as polarity disagreements.

causal_direction.description: The causal arrow between subject and object

physical_scale.description: The physical scale at which this claim operates. Domain-pack-scoped: the consciousness pack uses quantum through phenomenal. The physics pack adds planck and metaphysical. An additional cosmological value is available for astrophysics domains.

measurability.description: Whether this claim is currently measurable

measurable_with.description: The specific instrument name, if measurable. Required when measurability is measurable_now.

relation.description: The typed relation connecting subject and object. Must conform to the domain pack's ontology. Consciousness pack: grounds, entails, constrains, predicts_observable. Physics pack extends with additional relation types per domain.

domain.description: The field the source belongs to. Used for cross-corpus gating (never match within the same domain).

source_sentence.description: The exact sentence in the source text from which this claim was extracted

provenance_hash.description: Content hash linking to the exact source location
